ayahOccurrences.text: وَلَمَّا فَصَلَتِ ٱلْعِيرُ قَالَ أَبُوهُمْ إِنِّى لَأَجِدُ رِيحَ يُوسُفَ ۖ لَوْلَآ أَن تُفَنِّدُونِ
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: وَلَمَّا فَصَلَتِ ٱلْعِيرُ قَالَ أَبُوهُمْ إِنِّى لَأَجِدُ رِيحَ يُوسُفَ ۖ لَوْلَآ أَن تُفَنِّدُونِ

lexSnapshot.wordGrammar: 2nd person masculine plural (form II) imperfect verb, subjunctive mood
lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: تُفَنِّدُونِ is in the derivative form: تُفَنِّد
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ف/ن/د   f–n–d branch, to branch out, faction; to be weak of mind or body, to become senile; to lie; to refute, to dispute; to err; to fall into factions, to take refuge. Of this root, تُفَنِّدون tufannidūn, occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
تُفَنِّد tufannid [imperf. of v. II, trans.] to refute, to deny; to describe as senile

(12:94) إِنِّي‏ ‏لأََجِدُ‏ ‏رِيحَ‏ ‏يُوسُفَ‏ ‏لَوْلاَ‏ ‏أَنْ تُفَنِّدُونِ I sense [find] Joseph’s scent, even though you may think I am senile.
